independent_approval.reviewer: Codex root independent AI source, physical-sense and minimum-card picture review
independent_approval.approved_brief: Show a complete staffed checkout lane: customer side, short goods belt or counter, and a register, with a shopper presenting purchases. Frame the lane as one place while the equipment stays subordinate. Reject a close-up of a register alone, a help desk, or a hotel reception. No readable payment credentials or brand marks.
independent_approval.source_findings: Five complete original models from the acquired Kenney Mini Market 1.0, Mini Characters 1.0 and Food Kit 2.0 CC0 packs form the selected scene. Geometry, materials, textures and skins are preserved. Employee idle at 0 seconds and shopper interact-right at 0.333 seconds are sampled original clips. The sixth inspected floor model remains retained but is absent from the compact selection.
visual_findings: Root inspected the source contact and all four complete composition images and native-size contacts containing four real WordCard states each.

Compact-three-quarter shows one complete checkout station with the shopper on the goods side and apron-wearing employee behind the payment terminal. The belt, register and groceries convey the payment area as one place.
The source poses are friendly, with no visible hand or body penetration in the selected view. The dark belt and terminal retain contrast at actual Match 126x72 and Memory 144x74 sizes.
The image remains identifiable under the real matched alpha and badge. Small grocery detail supports the whole scene; this is visual judgment and not a participant recognition result.

Compact-high remains technically intact but is less balanced. Both tiled views reduce useful subject area and have genuine floor framing failures. The original 72-check aggregate with two failures remains failed.
accepted_adaptations: Position, rotate and uniformly scale complete licensed model roots.
Sample included character animation clips at the exact recorded times.
Use the recorded orthographic camera and lighting, transparent render, alpha-margin crop and proportional downscale.

failed_aggregate.reason: Both tiled variants clip the complete floor at the viewport sides. The aggregate failed and remains failed; selected-candidate success is bounded to compact-three-quarter only.

independent_approval.production_delivery: Pending exact approved-byte copy and production media-loader, pixel, crop and cache-release verification. Direct scratch WordCard rendering does not establish production delivery.
